objections: Cells in published_weekly_stats are mostly 1-2 visits, so keeping exact ISO week alongside municipality, age band, sex and diagnosis group leaves cells far below the k>=5 target on (age band, sex, municipality, arrival week); week is the field most easily matched to dated news clips and social posts.
No listed utility task (H-U2..H-U8) uses this table; week-level time is already served by ed_visits, so dropping week here loses no listed utility while removing the main linkage handle.
